concept: Wired Memory Instrumentation and Static Activation Buffers
summary: Source-anchored research for Wired Memory Instrumentation and Static Activation Buffers. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Allocating inference memory as wired pages on macOS prevents the virtual memory subsystem from paging model weights to swap disks, ensuring consistent sub-millisecond tensor read latencies. (high confidence)
Pre-allocating static activation workspaces at engine startup eliminates dynamic memory allocation overhead and kernel locks during the generation loop. (high confidence)
